environment.description: Celery worker running on EC2 instance in public subnet. The upload API (Flask) is exposed on port 8080 via an Application Load Balancer with no listener rules beyond default forwarding. Any internet client can POST zip archives to /api/v1/documents/upload which writes to /var/lib/docproc/uploads/ and enqueues the Celery task. Worker runs as docproc user with write access to /var/lib/docproc/ and read access to /etc/. No chroot or container isolation.
